_formEndpoint: REQUIRED before go-live. Paste the POST URL of your form service (e.g. https://formspree.io/f/xxxxxxx or https://api.web3forms.com/submit), or the path to your own handler (e.g. /send.php). While this is empty the build prints a warning and the form falls back to a mailto: link so no enquiry is silently lost.

company._regCode: Fill in the Estonian registry code (registrikood). Left empty, the footer and JSON-LD simply omit it.
company._vatNumber: Fill in the VAT number (KMKR number), same behaviour.
